tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border. At the helm of a wooden sailing boat: his forearm rests on the varnished wheel, the field watch on his wrist square to camera, sea spray beading on the dial glass. He wears a navy waxed-cotton jacket with the sleeve pushed up. 85mm, framed from his shoulder to the wheel, his silver beard just in frame, grey sea and a white wake behind.
